rows.text:
Dreamless Coffee × Astral Express Collaboration now live! May this journey find its way to your taste buds!

During the collab, we're launching a full line of special drinks! Don't forget the Express Crew merch and 50% off your second cup!

Collaboration Drinks Collection

"Azure Dragon Cold Brew": The Xianzhou Luofu Whale-Tide Spring + Lunarescent Depths Impression Sparkling Water
"As refreshing as a seaside stroll along the Lunarescent Depths."


"Rosy Bubble Latte": Strawberry Cream Cap + Hearty Popping Candies
"Unleash your inner cutesy energy! Remember to snap a pic before you sip!"

"Galactic Baseballer Whirlwind Drink": Supernova Popping Boba + Classic SoulGlad
Bonus: Trashcan-shaped Coffee Mug with Bat-shaped Stirrer
"Rules are made to be broken!"

"Black Hole Mocha": Singularity Coffee Beans + Rich Cocoa Syrup
"Brace yourself for gravitational attraction."

"Conductor's Healthy Veggie & Fruit Juice": Carrot Juice + Fresh Fruit Pulp
Bonus: Conductor Pom-Pom Cup Sleeve with Different Facial Expressions
"Drink more juice for a healthy life, pom!"

Manager's Special!
"Navigator's Pour-Over Coffee": Miss Himeko's Secret Recipe (Classified)
The Nameless' unanimously voted favorite drink! One sip and you'll experience the thrill of superluminal warp!
"Just like Fuel!"

Collaboration Event Rules

Collaboration Slogan: To purchase the special collaboration drink, shout out loud to the staff "Help me, Conductor Pom-Pom!"

Second Cup At Half Price: Buy any two collab special drinks, and get 50% off your second drink!

Random Merch Giveaway: Buy any collab special drink and get a random Express Crew coaster!

* This event ends before the Astral Express arrives at Planarcadia. Dreamless Coffee reserves all rights of final interpretation.*
